   The user is directing development of the FV-Lang compiler project through multiple phases. Started this conversation requesting Phase 4 implementation (code generation). The user provides directional commands ("4 go", "계속", "go") to proceed through implementation stages. The intent is systematic phase-by-phase compiler development with comprehensive testing at each stage.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - IR (Intermediate Representation) - intermediate code between AST and native code
   - AST to IR conversion pipeline
   - Constant folding optimization
   - Dead code elimination
   - Control flow graph handling
   - Function signature handling and parameter passing
   - Scope management and variable lifetime tracking
   - Type system (8 type variants: Integer, Float, String, Boolean, Function, Array, Tuple, Unknown)
   - Symbol table with stack-based scope management

3. Files and Code Sections:

   Phase 4 Stage 1 Created/Modified Files:
   
   - src/ir.rs (500+ lines)
     - Purpose: Core IR definition for code generation
     - Contains IRNode enum with 11 variants (IntLiteral, FloatLiteral, StringLiteral, BoolLiteral, Variable, BinaryOp, UnaryOp, If, FunctionCall, Array, Index, Tuple, Assign, Return, Block)
     - Implements optimization methods: fold_constants(), eliminate_dead_code(), uses_variable()
     - Key code:
     ```rust
     pub enum IRNode {
         IntLiteral(i64),
         FloatLiteral(f64),
         StringLiteral(String),
         BoolLiteral(bool),
         Variable(String),
         BinaryOp { op: String, left: Box<IRNode>, right: Box<IRNode> },
         UnaryOp { op: String, operand: Box<IRNode> },
         If { condition: Box<IRNode>, then_block: Vec<IRNode>, else_block: Option<Vec<IRNode>> },
         FunctionCall { name: String, args: Vec<IRNode> },
         Array { elements: Vec<IRNode> },
         Index { expr: Box<IRNode>, index: Box<IRNode> },
         Tuple { elements: Vec<IRNode> },
         Assign { name: String, value: Box<IRNode> },
         Return(Box<IRNode>),
         Block(Vec<IRNode>),
     }
     ```

   - src/codegen.rs (expanded from ~118 to 400+ lines)
     - Purpose: AST to IR conversion engine
     - Added methods:
       - ast_to_ir(&mut self, program: &Program) → IRProgram
       - statement_to_ir(&mut self, stmt: &Statement) → IRNode  
       - expression_to_ir(&mut self, expr: &Expression) → IRNode
       - literal_to_ir(&self, lit: &Literal) → IRNode
     - Maintained backward compatibility with existing generate() method
     - Supports all expression types: literals, variables, binary/unary ops, function calls, arrays, tuples, if expressions
     - Key conversion example:
     ```rust
     pub fn expression_to_ir(&mut self, expr: &Expression) -> Result<IRNode, CompileError> {
         match expr {
             Expression::Literal(lit) => self.literal_to_ir(lit),
             Expression::Variable(name) => Ok(IRNode::Variable(name.clone())),
             Expression::BinaryOp { op, left, right } => {
                 let left_ir = self.expression_to_ir(left)?;
                 let right_ir = self.expression_to_ir(right)?;
                 Ok(IRNode::BinaryOp {
                     op: op.clone(),
                     left: Box::new(left_ir),
                     right: Box::new(right_ir),
                 })
             }
             // ... other cases
         }
     }
     ```

   - tests/ir_test.rs (300+ lines)
     - 18 comprehensive IR tests covering:
       - Literal types (Integer, Float, String, Boolean)
       - Variables and operations
       - Constant folding (addition, multiplication, floats, unary)
       - Dead code elimination
       - If statement optimization
       - Function calls and arrays
     - Tests verify fold_constants() produces correct optimizations and eliminate_dead_code() removes unused assignments

   - tests/codegen_test.rs (250+ lines)
     - 20 tests for AST to IR conversion
     - Tests for each expression type: literals (4), variables (1), binary ops (2), unary ops (2), function calls (1), arrays (1), indexing (1), tuples (1)
     - Statement tests: let binding, return, if/if-else
     - Complex tests: nested expressions, function definitions
     - Example test:
     ```rust
     #[test]
     fn test_codegen_binary_op_addition() {
         let mut gen = CodeGenerator::new();
         let expr = Expression::BinaryOp {
             op: "Plus".to_string(),
             left: Box::new(Expression::Literal(Literal::Integer(1))),
             right: Box::new(Expression::Literal(Literal::Integer(2))),
         };
         let ir = gen.expression_to_ir(&expr).unwrap();
         assert_eq!(ir.to_string(), "(1 Plus 2)");
     }
     ```

   - tests/stage2_functions_test.rs (newly created, 250+ lines)
     - 10 tests for functions and control flow
     - Tests cover:
       - Function definition with single/multiple parameters
       - Function bodies with multiple statements
       - Function calls with/without arguments and complex arguments
       - If statements (with/without else, nested)
       - Multiple function definitions
     - Example:
     ```rust
     #[test]
     fn test_function_definition_with_single_param() {
         let mut gen = CodeGenerator::new();
         let program = Program {
             definitions: vec![Definition::Function {
                 name: "double".to_string(),
                 params: vec!["x".to_string()],
                 body: vec![Statement::Return(Box::new(
                     Expression::BinaryOp {
                         op: "Star".to_string(),
                         left: Box::new(Expression::Variable("x".to_string())),
                         right: Box::new(Expression::Literal(Literal::Integer(2))),
                     },
                 ))],
             }],
         };
         let ir = gen.ast_to_ir(&program).unwrap();
         assert_eq!(ir.functions.len(), 1);
     }
     ```

   - src/lib.rs
     - Added: `pub mod ir;` to module declarations
     - Enables ir module usage throughout project

   - docs/PHASE4_계획.md
     - Detailed 5-stage plan for Phase 4
     - Stage 1: IR definition & basic generation (2-3h)
     - Stage 2: Functions & control flow (2-3h)
     - Stage 3: Memory & arrays (2-3h)
     - Stage 4: Optimization passes (2-3h)
     - Stage 5: Integration & docs (2-3h)

   - docs/PHASE4_진행_상황.md

4. Errors and fixes:

pub enum IRNode {

#### 불필요한 코드 제거 (Dead Code Elimination)

let unused = 42;  // 사용되지 않으면 제거
let used = 10;
x = used;         // 유지
```

#### 조건 단순화 (Constant Condition Simplification)
```

    block_a
} else {
    block_b
}

block_a  // 직접 실행
```

    pub params: Vec<(String, Type)>,
    pub return_type: Type,
    pub body: Vec<IRNode>,

    pub functions: Vec<IRFunction>,

}

pub enum IRNode {

    IntLiteral(i64),
    FloatLiteral(f64),
    StringLiteral(String),
    BoolLiteral(bool),

    // 변수
    Variable(String),

    BinaryOp { op, left, right },
    UnaryOp { op, operand },

    // 제어 흐름
    If { condition, then_block, else_block },

    Index { expr, index },
    Tuple { elements },

    // 다중 명령
    Block(Vec<IRNode>),
}
```

```
1 + 2 → 3 (컴파일 타임에 계산)
true && false → false
-5 → -5
```

#### 불필요한 코드 제거 (Dead Code Elimination)
```
let unused = 42;  // 사용되지 않으면 제거
let used = 10;
x = used;         // 유지
```

#### 조건 단순화 (Constant Condition Simplification)
```
if (true) {
    block_a
} else {
    block_b
}
↓
block_a  // 직접 실행
```

### 3. IRFunction 및 IRProgram

```rust
pub struct IRFunction {
    pub name: String,
    pub params: Vec<(String, Type)>,
    pub return_type: Type,
    pub body: Vec<IRNode>,
}

pub struct IRProgram {
    pub functions: Vec<IRFunction>,
    pub main: Vec<IRNode>,
}
```

### 1. IR 정의 (src/ir.rs, 500+ 줄)

#### IRNode enum (10개 변종)
```rust
pub enum IRNode {
    // 리터럴
    IntLiteral(i64),
    FloatLiteral(f64),
    StringLiteral(String),
    BoolLiteral(bool),

    // 변수
    Variable(String),

    // 연산
    BinaryOp { op, left, right },
    UnaryOp { op, operand },

    // 제어 흐름
    If { condition, then_block, else_block },

    // 함수
    FunctionCall { name, args },

    // 배열/튜플
    Array { elements },
    Index { expr, index },
    Tuple { elements },

    // 변수 할당
    Assign { name, value },

    // 반환
    Return(Box<IRNode>),

    // 다중 명령
    Block(Vec<IRNode>),
}
```

#### 주요 메서드
- `returns_value()`: 값을 반환하는지 확인
- `fold_constants()`: 상수 폴딩 (컴파일 타임 계산)
- `eliminate_dead_code()`: 불필요한 코드 제거

### 2. 최적화 기법

#### 상수 폴딩 (Constant Folding)
```
1 + 2 → 3 (컴파일 타임에 계산)
true && false → false
-5 → -5
```

#### 불필요한 코드 제거 (Dead Code Elimination)
```
let unused = 42;  // 사용되지 않으면 제거
let used = 10;
x = used;         // 유지
```

#### 조건 단순화 (Constant Condition Simplification)
```
if (true) {
    block_a
} else {
    block_b
}
↓
block_a  // 직접 실행
```

### 3. IRFunction 및 IRProgram

```rust
pub struct IRFunction {
    pub name: String,
    pub params: Vec<(String, Type)>,
    pub return_type: Type,
    pub body: Vec<IRNode>,
}

pub struct IRProgram {
    pub functions: Vec<IRFunction>,
    pub main: Vec<IRNode>,
}
```

- `eliminate_dead_code()`: 불필요한 코드 제거

### 2. 최적화 기법

#### 상수 폴딩 (Constant Folding)
```
1 + 2 → 3 (컴파일 타임에 계산)
true && false → false
-5 → -5
```

#### 불필요한 코드 제거 (Dead Code Elimination)
```
let unused = 42;  // 사용되지 않으면 제거
let used = 10;
x = used;         // 유지
```

#### 조건 단순화 (Constant Condition Simplification)
```
if (true) {
    block_a
} else {
    block_b
}
↓
block_a  // 직접 실행
```

### 3. IRFunction 및 IRProgram

```rust
pub struct IRFunction {
    pub name: String,
    pub params: Vec<(String, Type)>,
    pub return_type: Type,
    pub body: Vec<IRNode>,
}

pub struct IRProgram {
    pub functions: Vec<IRFunction>,
    pub main: Vec<IRNode>,
}

    IntLiteral(i64),
    FloatLiteral(f64),
    StringLiteral(String),
    BoolLiteral(bool),

    Variable(String),

    BinaryOp { op, left, right },
    UnaryOp { op, operand },

    // 제어 흐름
    If { condition, then_block, else_block },

    // 함수

    // 배열/튜플
    Array { elements },
    Index { expr, index },
    Tuple { elements },

    // 변수 할당
    Assign { name, value },

    // 반환

    // 다중 명령

}
```

    block_a
} else {
    block_b
}

block_a  // 직접 실행

pub fn ast_to_ir(&mut self, program: &Program) -> Result<IRProgram, CompileError> {
    let mut functions = Vec::new();
    for definition in &program.definitions {
        match definition {
            Definition::Function { name, params, body } => {
                let ir_body: Vec<_> = body
                    .iter()
                    .map(|stmt| self.statement_to_ir(stmt))
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;

                let ir_func = IRFunction {
                    name: name.clone(),
                    params: params
                        .iter()
                        .map(|p| (p.clone(), Type::Unknown))
                        .collect(),
                    return_type: Type::Unknown,
                    body: ir_body,
                };
                functions.push(ir_func);
            }
            // ...
        }
    }
    Ok(IRProgram { functions, main: vec![] })
}

**코드 예시**:
```rust
pub fn ast_to_ir(&mut self, program: &Program) -> Result<IRProgram, CompileError> {
    let mut functions = Vec::new();
    for definition in &program.definitions {
        match definition {
            Definition::Function { name, params, body } => {
                let ir_body: Vec<_> = body
                    .iter()
                    .map(|stmt| self.statement_to_ir(stmt))
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;

                let ir_func = IRFunction {
                    name: name.clone(),
                    params: params
                        .iter()
                        .map(|p| (p.clone(), Type::Unknown))
                        .collect(),
                    return_type: Type::Unknown,
                    body: ir_body,
                };
                functions.push(ir_func);
            }
            // ...
        }
    }
    Ok(IRProgram { functions, main: vec![] })
}
```

```rust
pub struct FVCompiler {
    lexer: Lexer,
    parser: Parser,
    type_checker: TypeChecker,
    codegen: CodeGenerator,
    runtime: Runtime,
}

impl FVCompiler {
    pub fn compile_and_run(&mut self, source: &str) -> Result<Value, CompileError> {
        let tokens = self.lexer.tokenize(source)?;
        let ast = self.parser.parse(tokens)?;
        let ast = self.type_checker.check(ast)?;
        let ir = self.codegen.ast_to_ir(&ast)?;
        let result = self.runtime.execute(&ir)?;
        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

#### 2. CLI Interface (명령줄 인터페이스)

pub struct FVCli;

impl FVCli {
    pub fn run(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        match args[1].as_str() {
            "run" => Self::run_file(&args[2])?,
            "eval" => Self::eval_code(&args[2])?,
            "compile" => Self::compile_file(&args[2], &args[3])?,
            _ => println!("Usage: fvc [run|eval|compile] <file>"),
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn run_file(filename: &str) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let source = std::fs::read_to_string(filename)?;

        let result = compiler.compile_and_run(&source)?;

        Ok(())
    }
}

pub struct FVCompiler {

    parser: Parser,
    type_checker: TypeChecker,
    codegen: CodeGenerator,
    runtime: Runtime,
}

impl FVCompiler {
    pub fn compile_and_run(&mut self, source: &str) -> Result<Value, CompileError> {
        let tokens = self.lexer.tokenize(source)?;
        let ast = self.parser.parse(tokens)?;
        let ast = self.type_checker.check(ast)?;
        let ir = self.codegen.ast_to_ir(&ast)?;
        let result = self.runtime.execute(&ir)?;
        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

pub struct FVCli;

        match args[1].as_str() {
            "run" => Self::run_file(&args[2])?,
            "eval" => Self::eval_code(&args[2])?,
            "compile" => Self::compile_file(&args[2], &args[3])?,
            _ => println!("Usage: fvc [run|eval|compile] <file>"),
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn run_file(filename: &str) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let source = std::fs::read_to_string(filename)?;
        let mut compiler = FVCompiler::new();
        let result = compiler.compile_and_run(&source)?;
        println!("{}", result);
        Ok(())
    }
}
